risk.detail: This change controls the default verification depth for every future Work Item; conservative fallback, fail-closed override handling, and installed-adopter parity are therefore required.

observedIssues: Initial routing treated generated lifecycle evidence as governance changes and always escalated; explicit evidence-only patterns now preserve receipt visibility without raising the profile.
The first complete test run exposed five compatibility and installer-boundary regressions; focused fixes restored legacy committed-diff behavior and adopter target ownership.
The first passing functional suite produced exact coverage 85.099075 below the 85.10 threshold; a real CLI end-to-end regression test raised verified coverage to 85.24 without lowering the threshold.

The first canonical Strict run passed all 1715 tests but exposed two new low-risk Bandit findings for the router's fixed list-form Git subprocess; precise B404/B603 rationale annotations preserve the unchanged security baseline.

residualRisks.detail: New sensitive path families must be added to the versioned policy or they conservatively fall back to Standard rather than Strict.
The repository validates override completeness, freshness, scope, and evidence text but does not authenticate the human identity named by that evidence.
Installed adopters must configure AI_COCKPIT_RELEASE_CHECK before Release can pass; the default intentionally fails closed.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
expectedReviewFocus: Conservative path precedence and evidence-only lifecycle handling
Make target ownership without duplicated quality gates

userCorrectionsCaptured: Continue all Work Items without pausing unless a real human decision or external permission blocker occurs.
Keep verification lightweight where possible without lowering required quality.
userCorrectionSolidification: The execution plan treats the user's standing authorization as approval for bounded implementation and governance decisions.

knownGaps: Canonical ai-finish/archive verification evidence, Hosted CI, PR merge, lifecycle closure, and branch cleanup remain until those actions complete.

overclaimPrevention: The implementation selects repository verification profiles and validates evidence structure.
